title: Which gauge composition
question: The gauge board is locked. Which composition should the counter be built from?

options.label: Dial first
options.thesis: One large dial leads. The queue is a row of smaller dials under it.
options.viewport: The selected part fills the screen. The needle meets the red request mark.
options.risk: The queue can shrink until a clerk cannot scan the other jobs.

options.label: Queue first
options.thesis: The requisition queue is the top row. The large dial is the job you opened.
options.viewport: Four small dials across the top, then one large dial for 100331.
options.risk: The top row can turn into four equal heroes and the selected job loses rank.

options.label: Tick strip and dial
options.thesis: A dense list of tick strips on the left, one dial for the open part on the right.
options.viewport: Left third is the parts. Right two-thirds is the dial, with Approve under it.
options.risk: The strips can become a plain table and the dial becomes decoration.
